review_run.feedback: With 738 items and only commit subjects as leads, I could not confirm most 'done' calls. The same owner dictation shows up two or three times (p5/p4172, p383/p4436, p488/p4510, p586/p4577) as separate items, so one decision gets judged repeatedly. Merging near-duplicate items or linking them with a 'repeat of' field would cut the work. The 'cands' lists were often wrong, for example one item matched only 'task' or 'session' and pulled in unrelated commits. A per-item hit on file paths from the commit diff would be a stronger lead than subject words. Questions and statements need a rule for when a chat answer counts as 'rejected', since most of them are really 'answered'. A fifth state such as 'answered' would be clearer than reusing 'rejected'.
